review_status: predeclared engineering comparison; independent scientific review pending
rationale: The published field is an integer in meters. A 1 m absolute allowance accommodates sub-meter aggregation and final integer encoding; it is not a terrain-accuracy claim. Every paired basin must pass. Larger differences are investigated, never absorbed by post-hoc tolerance changes.
reference: BasinATLAS v1 level12, cached project attribute table; source and selected-record hashes are stored per run
missing_policy: Do not compare missing reference values or substitute zero for missing DEM cells. Report any excluded pair and fail complete-coverage gate.
limitations: Original HydroSHEDS native zone raster is reconstructed from unsimplified basin polygons with cell-center assignment.
Exact ArcGIS intermediate numeric storage/rounding is not established; preserve floating 5x5 means and compare against published integer values.
No coastal or interior void filling is inferred; partial/missing source blocks fail the completeness gate.
Pskem gauge catchment is provisional; the 20 native sub-basin identities remain explicit.
A successful comparison is not an independent scientific rerun or a released reproduction.
